data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable prior year claims development of GBP 24.7m (2015 - GBP 20.2m) was experienced in 2016, predominantly in respect of Property and Marine & Energy lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims activity due to the benign claims environment.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a favourable prior year development of GBP 24.7m (a release), driven by benign claims experience predominantly in Property and Marine & Energy lines. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 244.293m. The release reduced previously recorded reserves and is described by the Syndicate as arising from lower than expected claims activity during the period.
raw_causal_phrases: benefitted from positive development on prior year claims reserves of GBP 24.7m (2015 - GBP 20.2m), predominantly in respect of Property and Marine & Energy lines of business, as a result of lower than expected claims activity due to the benign claims environment.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position technical provisions (claims outstanding) prior-year column. Prior year development figure (GBP 24.7m) is reported in the Claims Outstanding note and director's narrative as 'favourable prior year claims development' - the note context is the gross claims outstanding note so this has been treated as a gross release. No LOB-level quantification provided. Claims development triangle present (gross) used for cross-checking but triangle contains an aggregate 'Pre-2011' column which was excluded.
